submitted.rationale: Mg–Sb–O has a wide band gap, so under 2.7 eV light every composition gave near-zero EQE. The only consistent signal is at the Sb-rich end: 0.00101% at x=0.795 and 0.00127% at x=0.816. This may come from Sb-oxide phases that absorb some sub-gap light. Index 28 had the highest measured EQE.
